auth_methods.quote: Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
auth_methods.note: API v3 uses a workspace API key sent as a Bearer header (api_key/bearer same class). OAuth exists only for the MCP server, not the REST API.

credential_access.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans . On all other plans, you'll still have access to a limited set of free test queries .
credential_access.note: Paid plan (Lite+) needed; only limited free test queries (ahrefs.com/yep/firehose targets) otherwise.

production_gate.quote: To send requests to Ahrefs API, you'll need an API key.
production_gate.note: No app review, marketplace or partner step documented for API use; customer brings own paid plan and key.

api_type.quote: The reference contains an OpenAPI-compatible specification of each endpoint's request and response format.
api_type.note: REST API v3 with OpenAPI spec.

mcp_official.note: Vendor-hosted remote MCP server on docs.ahrefs.com / api.ahrefs.com (paid plans Lite+).

main_blocker_type.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans .
main_blocker_type.note: Paid subscription is the gating obstacle; technically straightforward REST + key.
